verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that Canny offers an embeddable widget for web and mobile, but only page titles are shown. Nothing documents customizing the widget's label or colors to match a brand. The llms.txt probe text is truncated at 'widget cu', which is too thin to count as support for label or color customization.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can customize the feedback widget's label and colors to match my brand
